title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
@cursor Part 5 of 5 for issue #4: Incremental DOM mutations.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and QA), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #4, then do ONLY Part 5.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): add seeded mutation fuzz test (#4)` with the fuzz test (it may fail if it finds bugs). Then, for every bug it finds, a fix commit `fix(recorder): <short bug title> (#4)`. If the fuzz test passes on the first try, there is nothing to fix; say so in your note.

Prompt: Add a fuzz test with a seeded random generator: 200 random DOM operations, then compare live DOM with `rebuild(events)` from `packages/recorder/test-utils/rebuild.ts`. Fix every bug it finds.

Requirements:
- Fixed seed, deterministic (a small seeded PRNG in the test, no `Math.random`, no real timers)
- Run 5 different fixed seeds
- Operations should mix: append, insertBefore, remove, move an existing node, nested adds, attribute set and remove, text changes, and several operations inside one batch before flushing
- List any bugs found and fixed in the PR note
- Mark the PR as ready for review

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Fuzz test runs in under 5 seconds

Commit message for the test: `test(recorder): add seeded mutation fuzz test (#4)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@user
